How to use this list

Raw numbers do not win fights on their own. A top-attack Pal with a poor partner skill underperforms a slightly weaker Pal that fits your team, and a fast mount is only worth it if you actually travel. Use this ranking to shortlist candidates, then check the individual Pal against your base and party setup before you invest breeding time.

Frequently asked questions

What Pal has the highest highest attack?

Astralym, at 200.

How many Pals are ranked here?

302 Pals have a recorded value for this stat.

Does a higher value always mean better?

No. Partner skills, element matchups and your base layout matter as much as the raw number.
